Yes, the employer likely can enforce the covenant, because keeping her employed for two years after she signed is adequate consideration under the rule in jurisdictions like Illinois (*Fifield v. Premier Dealer Services*), which revises my earlier answer that continued at-will employment was illusory. The shared note's first option is not the right rationale, since most states require new consideration for a mid-employment covenant rather than treating a modification as needing none. Enforceability still depends on the governing state's law and on whether the two-year scope and duration are reasonable.

CONFIDENCE: 70
